parts:
I've just reported a bug on github.  I report it here for completeness.


I have a problem displaying a HTML page that contains a leaflet map. It is all well and working if I need to display just that, but my application is multi-tab with various levels of tabsetpanels.

Basically only the upper left corner of the map is displayed, till one resize the browser window.

I create some code that reproduce the problem here:
https://gist.github.com/smartinsightsfromdata/53029bce950049b8beab

This is the error that it is generated:
